research_objects.title: Marketing pro AI startupy & SaaS: copywriting a SEO pro vývojáře LLM a aplikací umělé inteligence
research_objects.description: An author-written professional article exploring the reciprocal relationship between professional communication expertise and AI products. It explains how SEO, copywriting, journalism/PR, psychology, and cross-domain commercial experience can help AI startups and SaaS developers with brand discoverability, positioning, product communication, audience understanding, and translating technical capabilities into customer-relevant language. It also compares major AI systems through their practical strengths, limitations, and workarounds from the perspective of an information professional.
components: SEO, brand visibility, and discoverability for AI products and services
copywriting and translation of technical product capabilities into customer-relevant language
journalism, public relations, and cross-platform brand communication
psychology, customer perspective, and reduction of domain blindness
comparative discussion of ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Mistral AI, DeepSeek, Perplexity, Gemini, and Monica.im
practical observations on Czech-language processing, text generation, research, context retention, and everyday professional use
source material for an eight-slide SlideShare presentation
research_objects.role_in_genealogy: A pre-DIO professional and conceptual precursor. The article is preserved in an Internet Archive capture from 12 March 2025, with a second archived copy providing corroboration. Its exact original publication date is not established. It already articulates a reciprocal relationship between professional capabilities (SEO, copywriting, journalism/PR, psychology, and commercial experience) and AI products and systems. It contextualizes the later AI-assisted exploratory environment, while the multimodal professional ethnography remains the primary research object from which DIO was explicitly derived.
research_objects.publication_date_basis: Exact original publication date is not established. The earliest supplied archive capture proves that the article was online no later than 12 March 2025.
research_objects.last_updated_date_basis: Current article page byline; the author confirms this is the date of the latest update, not the original publication date.

conceptual_themes.description: How SEO, copywriting, journalism/PR, psychology, and commercial experience can contribute to AI products through discoverability, positioning, product explanation, user-oriented communication, and brand development.

How different AI systems can support research, writing, synthesis, and information work, alongside their observed limitations in context retention, factual sourcing, language quality, consistency, and instruction following.

A practical account of complementary capabilities: human professional judgment and domain-bridging communication applied to AI products, and AI tools used to extend parts of professional information work.

research_processes.title: AI-assisted secondary exploration of the professional-ethnography object

temporal_scope.basis: Author-maintained changelog milestones; individual exploratory artefacts may have separate or undetermined dates.

research_processes.summary: The professional ethnography became the subject of iterative secondary exploration through AI-assisted machine readings and model-generated interpretations. These readings were examined in relation to the source text and its context. Their cross-domain associations, interpretive discrepancies, implicit readings, and algorithmic noise became material for the author's inquiry. The exploratory process contributed to the discovery and articulation of DIO, followed by the differentiation and articulation of ODI as its broader theoretical layer.
process_characteristics: iterative rather than strictly linear inquiry
secondary exploration of an existing multimodal source object
comparison of interpretations with the source text and surrounding context
attention to implicit meaning, cross-domain associations, and interpretive discrepancies
authorial synthesis and progressive conceptual articulation

roles.author: Research direction, selection and contextualization of source material, interpretation of model outputs, and conceptual synthesis.
roles.ai_systems: Generative and analytical systems used to produce secondary readings and expose patterns, associations, and interpretive differences in the source object.

The article's content discusses both the contribution of professional communication and information skills to AI products and the practical strengths and limitations of individual AI systems.
